mainEntity.name: What is an ADU feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ADU feasibility consultation assesses the potential for adding an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) to your property. It typically involves reviewing zoning codes, site conditions, and your project goals to determine if an ADU is permissible and practical. Hometelligent focuses on properties within Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville, understanding the specific local regulations that impact ADU development.
